description: Local hooks and an opt-in measuring proxy for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, VS Code): reports or masks secrets and personal data in prompts and tool traffic, and measures what a session sent and cost.
rules: The command is `shim`, the PyPI package is `shim`, the repository and product are shim-cli; write the name in lowercase.
Claude Code and Codex cannot have a typed prompt masked; shim reports it, and blocks it under `[mode] user-prompt = "enforce"`. GitHub Copilot CLI replaces the prompt the model sees.
Claude Code tool inputs and results are masked by default; VS Code tool results are reported only.
`shim watch` supports Claude Code only, forwards bytes unchanged and never modifies a request.
Pipe text to `shim scan` or `shim redact` on stdin; never pass it as an argument.
Use `--json` and the exit codes in scripts and agents; JSON errors carry `code` and `fix`.
Windows is not supported; use WSL, macOS or Linux.
Settings live in `~/.config/shim/config.toml`; change them with `shim config`, never by editing a client's settings file.
